title: Cozy East Nashville Studio
description:
This brand new build is located 2 miles from Broadway in East Nashville's Cleveland Park neighborhood walking distance to local coffee shops, breweries, and restaurants. Its also a minute away from highway entrance & exit access making it a quick uber to anywhere in the city. It features a cozy king bed, bathroom, kitchen with brand new appliances, Keurig duo coffee machine, ninja blender, swivel mount smart tv, washer & dryer, closet, dresser, fenced in yard, & two driveway parking spots.

The space
The private rental unit includes access through the alley with two driveway parking spots and a private fenced in yard. It is a private unit (not attached to any other units)

Guest access
Guests will be given a door code prior to check in to use during their stay.

Other things to note
Early check in & late check out may be available upon request depending on other bookings. If that’s not possible we can most likely accommodate storing luggage.
